meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, FLUX, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 AI 模型生成或编辑各类图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成或修改视觉素材
copy.tagline_en: Generate or edit images with AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create or edit visual assets

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude 可以通过运行脚本来生成或编辑图像，使用 OpenRouter 上的 AI 模型（如 Gemini、FLUX）。你需要先设置 OpenRouter API 密钥，然后描述想要的画面或编辑指令，Claude 就会调用对应模型生成图片并保存为 PNG 文件。
howto.when: 当你需要创建照片、插画、概念艺术、视觉素材，或对现有图片进行修改（例如改色、加元素）时触发。注意：流程图、电路图等请使用 scientific-schematics 技能。

say.text: 生成一幅日落山景的照片
say.note: 使用默认 Gemini 模型生成。

say.text: 把这张照片的天空改成紫色
say.note: 传入图片并指定编辑指令。

say.text: 用 FLUX.2 Pro 画一只太空猫

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude can generate or edit images by running a script that calls OpenRouter AI models (e.g., Gemini, FLUX). You need to set up an OpenRouter API key, then describe the desired image or editing instructions. Claude will invoke the model and save the result as a PNG file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to create photos, illustrations, concept art, visual assets, or edit existing images (e.g., change colors, add elements). For flowcharts or technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

say_en.text: Generate a photo of a sunset over mountains
Change the sky in this photo to purple
say_en.note: Provide input image and edit instruction.

say_en.text: Draw a cat in space using FLUX.2 Pro
